items.question: What details help with a roller rink rental quote?
items.answer: Helpful details include event date, venue address, available space, surface type, guest count, rental duration, access notes, and add-on needs.

items.question: Can portable roller rinks support different event types?
items.answer: Yes. The same planning flow can support schools, corporate gatherings, private parties, community events, and venue activations.
